title: Canonical active-parameter root charts and their puncture maps
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring, $r,p,n\in\mathbb N$, $t:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to B$, and $q\in\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-scheme]. Let $H$ be a commutative $B_q$-algebra, and put $f=\prod_i t_i$ (the empty product is $1$). Define the ordered active list $a(t,q)$ by retaining, in their original order and with repetitions, precisely those $t_i$ lying in $q$. Define $c_q:B\to H$ to be the composite $B\to B_q\to H$, and define the local parameter tuple $s:\{0,\ldots,|a(t,q)|-1\}\to H$ by $s_j=c_q(a(t,q)_j)$. Let $T_p(H,s)$ be the compatible prime-to-$p$ root algebra [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module]: explicitly it is $H[z_{j,m}:m>0,\ (m,p)=1]/(z_{j,m}^m-s_j,\ z_{j,m}^{m/d}-z_{j,d}\text{ for }d\mid m)$. Define $\ell:\operatorname{Spec}T_p(H,s)\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ using the coefficient composite $B\xrightarrow{c_q}H\to T_p(H,s)$. Define $j:\operatorname{Spec}B[1/f]\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ by localization. Define the local puncture map to be the first projection $\operatorname{Spec}B[1/f]\times_{\operatorname{Spec}B}\operatorname{Spec}T_p(H,s)\to\operatorname{Spec}B[1/f]$, using $j$ and $\ell$. Finally define the finite simultaneous root projection $\operatorname{Spec}(B[x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1}]/(x_i^n-t_i)_i)\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ by the coefficient map. These are definitions for arbitrary $B,H,p,n,r,t,q$: no regularity, SNC, strict henselian, positivity or coprimality condition is imposed on the ambient data; the prime-to-$p$ restriction belongs only to the indices of $T_p$. In geometric applications $H$ is the specified strict henselization and $p$ is the positive residue characteristic. The empty active list and $r=0$ are allowed.
